text: Select: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS CHEMBL_ID, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS NAME, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS SMILES, drug_indication.mesh_heading AS MESH_HEADING, drug_indication.efo_term AS EFO_TERM; Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication; Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno; Filter: molecule_dictionary.therapeutic_flag = 1 AND drug_indication.efo_term LIKE 'Prostate%'; Sort: molecule_dictionary.pref_name ASC; Limit: null
